name: finanzas-mcp
description: MCP server providing 25 financial calculation tools in Spanish: ratios, DuPont, Altman Z-Score, Piotroski F-Score, WACC, CAPM, DCF, multiples, NPV/IRR, break-even, AR aging, depreciation, loan amortization, indirect cash flow, and Chilean tax helpers. Pure computation, no external connections.
